messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — P1 embeddings latency spike in eu-west1 (alerts: 5xx-rate, p95-latency). Auto-bridge opened. Thread created 3141592653
Alex Morgan: I'm on. seeing 502s on the eu-west1 embeddings endpoint in grafana. high error rate since ~20:37 UTC.
Priya Shah: taking comms. I'll post customer-facing note when we have ETA.
Marta Lopez: I'm free to drive unless someone else is jumping in. what does the runbook say?
SRE Runbook Bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeddings-latency — steps: 1) check pods, 2) tail logs, 3) scale or restart pool, 4) fallback routing.
Jamal Reed: quick check — load looks normal but tail latency goes up with certain request patterns (long prompt prefixes). can someone grab a tail of the embeddings-worker logs?
Alex Morgan: grabbing logs now.
Alex Morgan: ```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings-worker --since=5m | tail -n 200
[2026-03-15T20:36:55Z] ERROR compute: kv-cache miss, fallback to slow path
[2026-03-15T20:37:12Z] ERROR http: upstream returned 502
[2026-03-15T20:37:23Z] WARN  batching: batch size 1 spikes
```
Marta Lopez: looks like a kv-cache regression on that variant. Have we rolled a model variant tonight?
Priya Shah: no release from model-onboard team in eu-west1 this window (checked deploy bot). (reaction: :eyes:)
Jamal Reed: OpsBot, what's the pool utilization?
OpsBot: embeddings-dedicated-euw1 pool uti: GPUs 87% (20/23), avg queue latency 120ms, burst queueing at 20:36 UTC.
Marta Lopez: high utilization + kv-cache miss -> some requests hit slow path and time out. plan: 1) shift traffic to fallback small-quantized variant, 2) scale pool by +2 nodes, 3) keep comms.
Alex Morgan: I can trigger the fallback routing. Priya will post status. Who is taking ownership for the next handoff window? my shift ends in 28m.
Priya Shah: I'll remain comms owner for the incident through the handoff. For driver: Marta, are you comfortable remaining primary until your oncall overlap with Jamal?
Marta Lopez: I can drive now, but I need a clean handoff to Jamal in ~25m. I'll document ops in the ticket.
Jamal Reed: I'll be secondary and ready to take over at 21:00 UTC. if scaling doesn't help in 10m, I'll flip routing fully to the fallback variant.
Priya Shah: posting customer note now: "We're investigating increased latency on Embeddings in eu-west1 affecting a subset of requests. Our on-call team is working on mitigation; next update in 15 minutes." (reaction: :thumbsup:)
Alex Morgan: I just applied temporary routing rule to divert 25% traffic to embeddings-v2-quant (fallback). monitoring now.
Alex Morgan: ```
# routing apply
redwoodctl route set --region eu-west1 --service embeddings --variant embeddings-v2-quant --percent 25
```
SRE Runbook Bot: Reminder: annotate incident ticket with exact commands executed and timestamps.
Marta Lopez: scaling +2 nodes now. ```
kc scale deployment embeddings-pool --replicas=25 -n inference
```
OpsBot: scale started, nodes provisioning. expected ready ~3m.
Alex Morgan: after routing + scale — error rate down from 14% -> 4% in last 2m. p95 latency improved 30%.
Priya Shah: next planned handoff: Marta -> Jamal at 21:00 UTC. Marta will remain driver until handoff; Jamal will be primary after 21:00. I'll stay comms until incident is resolved. if anyone else needs to swap, call it out now.
Marta Lopez: documented mitigation steps in the ticket, added runbook link and commands. I'll ping again 5m before handoff.
Jamal Reed: copy. I'll join the bridge early at 20:58 to sync.
Priya Shah: customer note updated: "Mitigation in progress; partial routing applied and additional capacity added. We're seeing improvements and will provide a full update at 21:00 UTC."
Alex Morgan: reassigning oncall ownership in pagerduty to Jamal for post-21:00. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Incident Bot: Pager duty assignment updated: primary -> Jamal Reed at 21:00 UTC.
Marta Lopez: handing over in 5m. key things for Jamal: monitor kv-cache miss rate, keep fallback routing at 25-50% until p95 stable <200ms, don't remove nodes until 10m steady.
Jamal Reed: noted. thanks Marta. I'll take over driver at 21:00 and keep Priya as comms.
Priya Shah: thanks team. tagging list for postmortem: model-onboard, infra-kernel, runtime. will open the incident ticket now.
Alex Morgan: nice work. closing bridge when postmortem triage ticket is created and latency is stable under threshold. (reaction: :partyparrot:)
